basics.name: Soumyakanti Pan
basics.label: Ph.D. Candidate in Biostatistics
basics.summary: Ph.D. candidate in Biostatistics at UCLA working on Bayesian modeling and inference for complex dependent non-Gaussian data.

highlights: Thesis: "Bayesian Modeling and Inference for Complex Dependent Non-Gaussian Data"
Thesis: "Distribution-free Correlation Based Tests to Differentiate Between Related Populations"

awards.summary: USD 20,000 in fellowship & USD 19,487 in tuition grant.

awards.title: Summer Mentored Research Fellowship
awards.summary: Awarded in 2022 and 2024; USD 12,000 total in fellowship over two summers.

publications.name: Bayesian Inference for Spatial-Temporal Non-Gaussian Data Using Predictive Stacking
publications.summary: Analysing non-Gaussian spatial-temporal data typically requires introducing spatial dependence in generalised linear models through the link function of an exponential family distribution.

publications.name: Bayesian Hierarchical Modeling and Inference for Mechanistic Systems in Industrial Hygiene
publications.publisher: Annals of Work Exposures and Health
publications.summary: A series of experiments in stationary and moving passenger rail cars were conducted to measure removal rates of particles in the size ranges of SARS-CoV-2 viral aerosols.

publications.name: Bayesian Inference for Spatially-Temporally Misaligned Data Using Predictive Stacking
publications.summary: This article develops a Bayesian hierarchical model to analyze spatially-temporally misaligned exposure and health outcome data.

projects.name: spStack
projects.summary: Bayesian Geostatistics Using Predictive Stacking. An R package delivering fast Bayesian inference for a class of geostatistical models.
